overview_description.description: Plobal Apps is a SaaS platform where brands build mobile apps in minutes with zero coding and enable e-commerce businesses to deliver mobile experiences with the help of AI. Plobal Apps helps online stores translate the high mobile traffic volume (81% of all Shopify traffic comes from mobile devices) into a high conversion rate and consequently higher revenue. The company doesn't just build apps for customers, but function as their app commerce partners and carve out a comprehensive mobile commerce success journey for them and help them drive installs, engage customers, and scale revenues.

product.name: Shopify Mobile App Builder
product.description: A no-code platform that converts Shopify stores into native mobile apps with customizable design and features.

product.name: App Customizations with Code Blocks
product.description: A feature allowing advanced customization of mobile apps using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to enhance app functionality and branding.

product.name: Push Notification Marketing Channel
product.description: A tool for sending targeted push notifications to app users to engage, acquire, and retain customers.

product.name: Live Selling Feature
product.description: A live video shopping feature that enables merchants to showcase products and engage customers in real-time within the app.

product.name: App Analytics Dashboard
product.description: A real-time analytics tool that tracks in-app user actions, customer engagement, and sales performance.

product.name: Omnichannel Solutions
product.description: Features that allow customers to order via the app and pick up in-store, supporting seamless shopping experiences across channels.
